colour_checks.what: §4.1 LI-27: the f^abc part of g g > a g (expected to vanish by C-parity) checked numerically, never removed by rule (Q13): per helicity row the difference of the two amplitude-basis anchors relative to their sum (Re(conj(a_t) (G a)_t), induced_observables: on a basis pair exchanged by the quark loop's orientation the difference is the d^abc-f^abc interference), at every fixture point, binary64 (within 10 x the point's relative estimate) and double-double (within the 1e-24 target); the control g g > z g (V_GGGZ: d + f) must exceed the same bounds (the check sees an f^abc part); the |f|^2 projection itself needs the loop amplitude's colour vector, which the public route does not serve
